title: Competing CTAs
summary: Multiple competing calls-to-action on the homepage create ambiguity about the primary next step, diluting conversion focus.
problem: Multiple competing calls-to-action on the homepage create ambiguity about the primary next step, diluting conversion focus.
recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: Single primary CTA: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Consolidate the primary CTA to a single action and relegate secondary actions to supporting roles or lower on the page.
evidence: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Generic value proposition
summary: The homepage headline claims reliability and nationwide coverage but does not explain what the product is or why it is better than alternatives.
problem: The homepage headline claims reliability and nationwide coverage but does not explain what the product is or why it is better than alternatives.
recommended_change: h1: Unlimited Wireless Internet for RVs, Rural Homes & Travelers; notes: Rewrite hero headline and subcopy to explicitly state that Nomad sells unlimited-data wireless internet for RVs, rural homes, and travelers, and lead with a concrete benefit such as no contracts or no hard data caps.
evidence: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S. | Internet That Just Works
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Pricing page error
summary: The /pricing page fails to render, breaking the path for users seeking plan details before conversion.
problem: The /pricing page fails to render, breaking the path for users seeking plan details before conversion.
recommended_change: notes: Investigate and fix the /pricing page so it loads correctly, or redirect users to /plans which contains the same pricing information.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

title: Pricing lacks plan context
summary: Prices appear as bare dollar figures without plan names, features, or differentiators, so visitors cannot judge which option fits them or why it is worth the cost.
problem: Prices appear as bare dollar figures without plan names, features, or differentiators, so visitors cannot judge which option fits them or why it is worth the cost.
recommended_change: notes: Pair each price with a plan name, headline feature, and a one-line benefit (e.g., 'Best for full-time RVers — truly unlimited data') so the offer is self-explanatory above the fold.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: One-time fees without context
summary: One-time costs appear alongside monthly prices without explanation of what they cover, potentially surprising visitors at checkout.
problem: One-time costs appear alongside monthly prices without explanation of what they cover, potentially surprising visitors at checkout.

evidence: A section heading reads “$0.00 (one-time)”. | A section heading reads “$99.99 (one-time)”.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Duplicate forms with identical submit
summary: Duplicate forms with identical CONTINUE submit buttons on multiple pages create a redundant or confusing step in the funnel.
problem: Duplicate forms with identical CONTINUE submit buttons on multiple pages create a redundant or confusing step in the funnel.
